name: center
description: A single- or both-axis Flexbox centring box (RFC 0022).

modifiers.name: axis
modifiers.description: Which axis (or axes) to centre content along.

options.name: horizontal
options.description: Centre the inline axis only; block-size stays content-driven.

options.name: vertical
options.description: Centre the block axis only; inline-size stays content-driven.
